subject: Quote HAM-TLV in USD
body:
Hi team,

we need your cheapest rate Hamburg (HAM) to Tel Aviv (TLV) for 2 drums of non-hazardous resin, 260 kg, 0.9 cbm, ready on 27 November, we deliver to HAM.

Our US parent pays the freight, so please quote all-in in USD, not EUR.

Best regards
Lisa Wagner
Logistics
Elbe Chemie GmbH
